content.value: Consider the solar celi that driving a typical load. This cell has an area of 3 cm × 3 cm and is illuminated with light of intensity 700 Wm-².Find the power delivered to the load, efficiency and fill factor of the solar cell. Assume that output current and voltage are 157 mA and 0.475 V and their maximum values are 178 mA and 0.58 V, respectively.
